meta.disclaimer: Fuel station availability and opening hours change. Distances are approximate planning figures — never run below a quarter tank on remote gravel. Jerry cans only where legal; declare at borders.
meta.sourceLabel: Operator route notes & national fuel retailers

intro: Self-drive incidents often start with an empty tank, not a flat tyre. These corridors list the last reliable fuel before long gaps — fill at every town marked bold.
goldenRules: Fill at every major town on the list — do not skip because the gauge looks fine
Carry 400+ km range on Namibia gravel; 250 km minimum elsewhere off main highways
95 octane may be unavailable at remote posts — 93 is common; know your rental's requirement
Cards fail at rural pumps — carry cash (NAD/ZAR, USD at some ZW/MZ posts)
Fuel queues in Zimbabwe and Malawi can take hours — plan morning fills in cities
